title: Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, and Efficacy of OTX-CSI in Subjects With Dry Eye Disease.
brief_summary: To assess the safety, tolerability and efficacy of a single dose of OTX-CSI, a sustained release cyclosporine drug product, in subjects with dry eye disease.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Dry eye disease diagnosis
* VAS eye dryness severity score ≥ 30.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Are unwilling to discontinue use of contact lenses
* Are unwilling to withhold use of artificial tears.
